captions.text: The RDP server needs a trusted identity
The private key stays on the server
The request is signed, not the key sent
The Root CA signs the issuing CA certificate
The Root CA is the trust anchor
The client validates the whole chain
Different templates can use different issuing CAs
Issuing CA 2 signs the TLS certificate
Different issuing paths. One trusted root.
Certificate Flow — From request to trust
